about_the_game:
Delfini is a gentle and delicate two-player cooperative ocean exploration game, it is about a moving journey where two dolphins bravely save the polluted coral reef island. In this clear ocean world, players will accompany two dolphins as they rescue their fellow sea creature friends, who are trapped by harmful substances, to encounter a story of friendship, hope, and healing.

You and your friend will guide these two dolphins to clean up the polluted coral reefs, which is not only about preserving the marine environment but also about building friendships and maintaining protection. During your exploration, the rescued sea creature friends will join your team to support and help you protect the coral world under the sea.

The soothing music, combined with the relaxing gameplay, will bring a calming and healing feeling to players, making Delfini a game where you can unwind with friends and soothe your soul from busy life routines. Here in Delfini, every action is meaningful, and every coral reef cleanup represents a new hope for the sea. Whether you are playing the game to protect the environment, for appreciation, or to feel touched by Delfini's poetic story, you will always find your own rhythm under the sea.
